text:
maria (PM): quick sync — proposing we trim tenant-level routing from MVP to avoid the Q2 launch slip. plan: ship org-level routing for mvp, reserve per-tenant routing for v1. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam (Engineering): ugh yeah that would cut a lot of infra complexity. rough estimate: tenant routing is ~3 sprints of infra+api work. if we remove it we can keep the current rollout date.

liam (Design): curious about UX fallout — customers expecting per-tenant controls in the console? we should check comms & admin UX so support isn't flooded.

nova (Eng-ML): technical note: per-tenant routing enables different model variants per tenant. without it, customers will share same model config; needs explicit opt-in later. signal/perf differences could be confusing.

alex (Eng-Infra): agree with sam. also simplifies metrics/tagging — we can avoid tagging requests by tenant until v1. ops win. But we need a migration plan for telemetry and billing tags.

jordan (Prod-Ops): support load = ? if we launch without per-tenant control, can we script a temporary knob for 2 big customers to get different models? like an ad-hoc ACL? would reduce risk.

maria (PM): good call. proposal: MVP = org-level routing + a small ad-hoc override mechanism for 2 top customers (manual config via ops). v1 = full per-tenant routing + console controls.

sam (Engineering): manual override via ops makes sense as a stopgap. implement as a lightweight routing table stored in k/v store, not full tenant service. estimate: +2 dev-weeks.

liam (Design): for comms: draft message telling customers we delayed per-tenant controls to v1 but give timeframes and the manual override for enterprise accounts. i can whip a short banner and a support playbook.

nova (Eng-ML): a couple of risks: 1) if two tenants need conflicting quantization/quant profiles, sharing model might cause quality regressions. we should add regression guards and eval prompt sets from those tenants before enabling shared config. 2) caching semantics: prefix cache at org-level might increase cross-tenant contamination. add cache-namespace isolation flag for manual overrides.

alex (Eng-Infra): add to migration checklist: billing tags, telemetry schema change, cache isolation, and feature flag gating. we should also pin model versions per rollout to avoid surprise drift.

maria (PM): ok action items. i'll summarize and assign: 
- maria: announce scope change to execs + customer comms (today)
- sam: implement lightweight ops override routing (2w)
- alex: migration checklist + telemetry plan (this sprint)
- nova: evals for top 2 customers' prompts (pair with sam)
- liam: comms banner + support playbook (ASAP)

Code snippet for the ops-override idea (very small):
```
# routing override (k/v)
{ "tenant_override": { "tenant-id-123": "model-x-v2", "tenant-id-456": "model-y-v1" } }
```

jordan (Prod-Ops): :thumbsup: can own the manual override entries + run the one-off deploys for the two customers.

sam (Engineering): if we accept this, we should update the launch criteria doc: 
- must have org-level routing stable under load
- manual override mechanism implemented and tested
- comms + support playbook ready
- telemetry tags defined and validated

maria (PM): agreed. updated launch checklist entry: "Tenant routing deferred to v1; ops-override for 2 enterprise customers required for MVP launch."

nova (Eng-ML): one more: add a post-launch evaluation window (2 weeks) to detect model-quality regressions for tenants on shared config. roll back to ops-override if issues.

liam (Design): and add a support FAQ snippet explaining why per-tenant controls are v1 and how manual overrides work.

maria (PM): thanks team. i'll post a short summary and update the milestone tracker. tentative timeline: MVP launch remains in 3 weeks if we accept cuts. if anyone objects, raise now.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: mvp-lite/2026-03-30 -> staging (CI OK)

sam (Engineering): no objections from me. :+1:

alex (Eng-Infra): sounds good. we'll keep the telemetry toggles behind feature flags.

maria (PM): final: proceed with MVP-lite cut. action owners above. i'll create follow-up tickets and link them in the milestone tracker. :white_check_mark:
